synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO derives ten percent and ninety percent POE forecasts by multiplicatively scaling the fifty percent POE forecast.
summary: AEMO defines the ten percent, fifty percent and ninety percent probability of exceedance demands as the three main types of POE demands used to determine a realistic range of power system and market outcomes [aemo_demand_terms#p25c56].

The ten percent and ninety percent POE forecasts are derived from the fifty percent POE forecast and are produced by multiplying the fifty percent POE forecast by a scaling factor; different scaling factors may be specified for each half-hour of the short term period and the scaling factors are based on statistical analysis of historical load and forecast data [aemo_so_op_3710#p7c14].

AEMO produces ten percent, fifty percent and ninety percent POE forecasts for all timeframes; the fifty percent POE forecast is used to set generation targets in pre-dispatch and the fifty percent and ten percent POE forecasts are used in STPASA to calculate reserve levels [aemo_so_op_3710#p5c5][aemo_demand_terms#p11c18].
